disorder-name.detail: 42 patients with schizophrenia were enrolled; 5 discontinued before the first session, leaving 37 for analysis. Diagnosis not explicitly stated as DSM-IV/5 in the main text, but the paper is focused on schizophrenia patients receiving antipsychotic treatment.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Forty healthy subjects and 42 patients with schizophrenia were enrolled and gave written informed consent... For the following data analysis, 37 subjects with a mean age of 28.41 yr (SD = 8.41) were included"
disorder-name.location: Lin2024.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Demographic data of the patients with schizophrenia, L51

dataset-of-origin.detail: The SCZ clinical cohort was recruited at Peking University Sixth Hospital; MRI scanning was performed at Peking University Third Hospital. No named public dataset was used for the clinical cohort. The Cam-CAN dataset was used only for normative model construction (healthy controls).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The Ethics Committee of the Peking University Sixth Hospital approved the study. Forty healthy subjects and 42 patients with schizophrenia were enrolled..." "Magnetic resonance imaging was performed using a Siemens Magnetom Trio 3.0 Tesla imaging system... at Peking University Third Hospital."
